meta.defaultTitle: Magnificent Travel | Tours across Turkey, Greece, Egypt, Jordan and Morocco
meta.defaultDescription: Licensed Turkish tour operator since 1997. Private, small group and multi-country tours across Turkey, Greece, Egypt, Jordan and Morocco.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.bestTime: April to June and September to October for sightseeing. Turkey can be visited all year.

greece.name: Greece
greece.bestTime: April to October, with the warmest sea in July to September.

egypt.name: Egypt
egypt.bestTime: October to April for cooler sightseeing. Tours run daily all year.

jordan.name: Jordan
jordan.bestTime: Spring and autumn are the most comfortable seasons. Summers are hot in the south.

morocco.name: Morocco
morocco.bestTime: Spring and autumn for most routes. The desert is best outside midsummer.

reasons.text: Chosen for location, cleanliness, comfort, service and traveler feedback.

tours.title: Explore Our Tours
tours.description: Browse private, small group and multi-country tours across Turkey, Greece, Egypt and Jordan. Filter by destination, travel style and duration.
tours.banner: Private, small group and multi-country journeys designed around you.
tours.lead: From the timeless wonders of Turkey to the sun-drenched islands of Greece and the ancient treasures of Egypt and Jordan, our tours bring you closer to the most extraordinary destinations. Travel your way, with the same exceptional care.

multi.title: Multi-Country Tours
multi.description: Multi-country tours across Turkey, Greece, Egypt and Jordan, with flights, ferries, hotels, transfers and guides coordinated by one licensed local team.
multi.banner: Seamlessly weave together diverse cultures and iconic landscapes in one journey.
multi.listTitle: Multi-country tours across the eastern Mediterranean
multi.listText: Choose a combination and we will shape the route, the length and the pace around you.
multi.teamText: Several countries in one trip means many moving parts. We handle them as a single itinerary.

items.title: Flights
items.text: International connections between countries and domestic flights within them.

items.title: Ferries
items.text: High-speed island ferries and port transfers in Greece.

items.title: Hotels
items.text: Carefully selected hotels in every city and region.

items.title: Guides and transfers
items.text: Licensed local guides and private transfers throughout.

multi.bandText: Tell us which places you cannot miss and we will shape a route around them.

private.title: Private Tours
private.description: Private tours in Turkey, Greece, Egypt and Jordan with your own licensed guide and vehicle. Your interests, your pace, one local team.
private.lead: Your interests. Your pace. A more personal way to see the world.

points.title: Your own guide and vehicle
points.text: A licensed local guide and a private vehicle stay with your party, so the day follows your interests.

points.title: Flexible pace
points.text: Start later, linger longer or skip a stop. The plan bends around you.

points.title: Tailored hotels and sightseeing
points.text: Choose hotel category, add nights and swap sights. We rebuild the itinerary to match.

points.title: Ideal for families and special occasions
points.text: Honeymoons, family trips and multigenerational journeys are easier to shape privately.

faqs.q: Is a private tour much more expensive?
faqs.a: It depends on group size and season. We quote clearly so you can compare private and small group options side by side.
Yes. The listed itineraries are starting points that we adapt to your dates, hotels and interests.

faqs.q: Are private tours available all year?
faqs.a: Most run daily throughout the year, subject to availability. Island tours in Greece run from April to mid October.

smallGroup.title: Small Group Tours
smallGroup.description: Small group tours in Turkey and Greece with licensed local guides. Meaningful travel with like-minded explorers. One local team arranges it all.

points.title: Small by design
points.text: Fewer travelers means easier access to sites, better conversation with your guide and a more relaxed day.

points.title: Everything arranged locally
points.text: Sightseeing, transport and guide services are arranged by our local team.

points.title: Good value
points.text: Sharing a guide and vehicle keeps the price lower than a fully private tour.

points.title: Easy to join
points.text: Daily departure options mean you can pick the date that suits you, subject to availability.

faqs.q: How big are your small groups?
faqs.a: Groups are kept small so the experience stays personal. We confirm the format and expected group size in your proposal.

faqs.q: Can I switch to a private tour?
faqs.a: Yes. Most small group itineraries can also run privately.

faqs.q: Are small group tours suitable for solo travelers?
faqs.a: Yes. They are a popular way for solo travelers to explore with company and support.

plan.title: Plan My Trip
plan.description: Tell us where you would like to go and get a personalized itinerary and quote from our travel experts. No obligation, and we reply by email or WhatsApp.
plan.banner: Share your dreams and our travel experts will create a tailored itinerary and quote. No obligation.

steps.title: You tell us your plans
steps.text: Destinations, dates, number of travelers and anything that matters to you.

steps.title: We send a proposal
steps.text: A route, hotels, what is included and a clear price, shaped around your answers.

steps.title: We refine it together
steps.text: Change anything you like. Confirm with a 50% deposit when you are ready.

plan.talkText: Message or call us and a travel consultant will help.
